final_project_goal: Use CF4 constraints to obtain a statistically valid z=0 local-universe density/velocity posterior, construct an exact q-corrected IC with conditional high-k structure, and forward-validate a zoom IC at an effective observational resolution of <=0.3 cMpc/h.
purpose: Test one non-bitwise, topology-aware approximation route for the frozen Q1 observation operator. Q7 does not produce a posterior, IC or <=0.3 cMpc/h claim; it only determines whether a scalable, error-certified z=0 operator is possible.

science_position.why_this_route: Q6 proved that bitwise complete knot signatures give G=M almost surely for continuous CF4 geometry and cannot scale. Q7 must obtain compression through bounded approximation while explicitly resolving TSC knots, seams and sigma regimes.
science_position.operator_first: No posterior or IC work is scientifically admissible until the approximate operator passes a frozen Q1 value/gradient/error/resource contract on development fixtures.
science_position.geometry_gradient_scope: Positions, LOS directions and sigma are fixed inputs in Q7. Only state-mass/latent/bias derivatives represented by the frozen 23 directions are in scope; geometry JVP/VJP is a separate future gate and must not be implied.

route.name: adaptive_topology_aware_response_atlas
route.representation: For each bounded geometry bin, first split on all TSC knot surfaces so every epsilon interval has a common stencil topology. Within a topology cell, approximate the 27-cell response vector only by an interval-enclosed representation; a low-order surrogate is allowed only when its residual is itself enclosed over the full topology cell and T=8. Heuristic or merely empirically bounded surrogates are forbidden. Store state-mass and the frozen 23 directional mass basis; geometry is not differentiated.
route.knot_rule: A bin may not straddle a TSC knot, periodic seam, sliver-merge boundary or sigma-zero policy boundary. If a split cannot establish this, fail closed to sourcewise evaluation and count the bin as overflow.
route.error_certificate: For each bin b and population/direction (p,j), compute interval-arithmetic enclosures of every response component w_c(z) over z in b and T=8. The certified contribution bounds include E_L1[p,j,b]=sum_i|d_j m_i|*sup||w-w_ref||_1, E_Linf[p,j,b]=max_c sum_i|d_j m_i|*sup|w_c-w_ref,c|, each seam/knot stratum bound, and for each fixed scientific-summary map A_s an induced bound E_s<=||A_s|| applied to the same response enclosure. The sum over bins must be below every corresponding frozen gate before any timing/resource claim.
route.state_contract: Mass and frozen directional mass derivatives are aggregated only after the certified response enclosure is formed. No fiducial pre-summing, secure-object substitution or mass-only anisotropic shortcut is allowed.
route.normalization: Use the frozen Q1 T=8 tail normalization and per-source conservation convention; any bin surrogate must preserve non-negativity and total mass within the certified error budget.
route.overflow_policy: If topology, interval arithmetic, cold-sigma handling or resource limits fail, retain the sourcewise Q1 response for that bin and report overflow fraction; no clipping or tolerance relaxation.
route.certificate_status_contract: Every gate is labeled CERTIFIED, MEASURED, or BOTH in the result. A measured pass without its certified counterpart cannot promote the route.

approximate_error_gates.reference: frozen Q1 sourcewise oracle on identical positions, LOS, sigma, masses and exposure
approximate_error_gates.value_total_and_per_population: L1 <= max(1e-12, 1e-3*oracle_l1), plus certified bin-bound sum <= the same gate
approximate_error_gates.value_cellwise: Require both certified E_Linf <= max(1e-12, 1e-4*max(oracle_field)) and measured Linf <= the same threshold; require both certified seam/knot stratum enclosures and measured strata p95 <= 1e-3 relative.
approximate_error_gates.gradient_23: For frozen 23 state-mass/latent/bias directions, L1 <= max(1e-10, 1e-3*reference_gradient_l1), with the same bound certified before measurement
approximate_error_gates.likelihood_budget: For each of the 175 fixed scientific summaries s, use normalized perturbation delta_l_s=abs(logL_candidate_s-logL_Q1_s)/max(1,abs(logL_Q1_s)) computed with identical exposure/data; require certified induced bound <=0.01 and measured delta_l_s <=0.01, with no summary coverage loss. This is an operator budget, not a posterior claim.
approximate_error_gates.topology_sigma: All seven Q6 fixture families (seeds 62001-62007), including TSC knots, periodic seam/sliver/clip, translated cells, interval order, LOS/sigma variation and sigma=0/near-zero, must have explicit CERTIFIED/MEASURED PASS or terminal NO-GO dispositions.
approximate_error_gates.approximation_not_exact: The Q6 exactness gate is not inherited as an approximate-route acceptance criterion; every Q7 gate reports measured error and certified bound separately.

resource_and_compression_gates.compression: Require measured M/G > 1.01; M/G <= 1.01 is immediate terminal NO-GO.
resource_and_compression_gates.memory: Persistent+temporary peak <= 64 GiB host and <= 16 GiB device before any device allocation or accelerator kernel; no JIT is in scope because jax=false.
resource_and_compression_gates.timing: After the full-N192 certified bound and measured Q1 comparison pass, warm synchronized full-field end-to-end <= 600 s at the 2.0 cMpc/h release point; no JIT is in scope because jax=false.
resource_and_compression_gates.measurement_scope: Development fixtures and, only after Q7.2 passes, full N192/2.0 cMpc/h. No extrapolation to 0.3 cMpc/h and no production allocation until all gates pass.
resource_and_compression_gates.full_N192_order: First compute certified bounds on the actual full source stream without device allocation; second perform a measured candidate-versus-Q1 sourcewise/full-field comparison; only then measure warm timing and persistent+temporary host/device peaks.

development_firewall.fixtures: Reuse all seven Q6 seeds/topology unchanged: 62001, 62002, 62003, 62004, 62005, 62006, 62007. The six families not executed in Q6 (62001-62005, 62007) must be generated from a committed deterministic generator before the first run.
development_firewall.fixture_hash: Record raw array digest with the Q6 generator's declared LE-float64 concatenation scope and a single project-wide canonical manifest digest.
development_firewall.selection: One route and frozen hyperparameters; no candidate switching or retuning after seeing any fixture result.
development_firewall.heldout: 256 Q4 held-out seeds remain sealed and one-shot; no held-out evaluation in Q7.

work_packages.task: Freeze topology partition, interval-enclosure arithmetic, surrogate basis, cold-sigma/sliver/clip rules, mass-only gradient scope, fixture generator and error-budget accounting.
work_packages.acceptance: Grok approves the plan; no code or fixture execution before user approval.

work_packages.task: Implement the single adaptive topology-aware route with runtime Q1 provenance guard and deterministic overflow accounting.
work_packages.acceptance: Code has no GPFS/Slurm/JAX/posterior/IC path, preserves the Q1 guard, and exposes certified value/23-direction mass-gradient errors.

work_packages.task: Run all seven pre-registered development fixture families and evaluate certified and measured value, cellwise, topology, sigma, 23-direction mass-gradient, 175-summary likelihood-budget and overflow gates.
work_packages.acceptance: Every one of the seven fixture families receives explicit CERTIFIED/MEASURED PASS or terminal NO-GO; no held-out data are opened.

work_packages.task: Only if Q7.2 passes, first certify the bound on the actual full N192 source stream and perform a measured candidate-versus-Q1 comparison; only then measure compression, warm timing and host/device peaks. Otherwise stop without allocation.
work_packages.acceptance: Full-N192 certified and measured gates pass, M/G > 1.01, peak <=64/16 GiB and warm time <=600 s, or route is terminal NO-GO.

release_gates: User explicitly approves Q7 before any code change or development fixture execution.
